name: USM desktop helper
description: For USM, the memory-overload guard: reports which app is in front (so the guard never pauses it and lets a paused app run again the moment you switch to it), how long you have been idle, and how late GNOME Shell itself runs (desktop lag) for USM's logs. Writes only $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/usm-desktop. No window titles. Adds USM to Quick Settings: VRAM swap tier and guard switches, status, mark a slow moment, live view.
